scope: Complete semantic extraction and section index; chapter-aligned selected passages reviewed, not a claim of every-word manual reading.
spoilerReview: Narration introduces premise, distinctive method, ethical tension and reading route; deaths, reversals and final resolutions omitted. Autopsy is philosophical experimentation and explicitly unvalidated.
sourceImages: One cover in each canonical English source; covers inspected together, no interior diagrams/photos to adapt. Original source-specific vectors authored.
exactEvidence: All claim spans begin in substantive chapter text, not table-of-contents or heading-only strings. Numeric IDs are explicit source-index mappings.
firstScene: Names the exact book and identifies genre, source-grounded reason to read and central tension. Root reviewed full scripts before voice; repetitive withholding boilerplate and generic reading instructions revised.
